description: Aru carries the north lantern at Quiet Rise.
Evin holds the south bell at Salt Court.
At the Chalk Stair, Aru and Evin agree to share stewardship for this crossing only, then chalk one temporary route mark.
At the Chalk Stair at tick 11, Aru reports waiting through the agreed bell and that Evin did not come; the note scopes the agreement to this crossing only and asserts no other duty or breach.
Evin reports being at Salt Court through the same agreed bell; the note asserts no accusation against Aru, selects no winner, and states that both first-person accounts stand unresolved.

At the Chalk Stair at tick 13, Aru reports receiving Evin's response and states that both first-person accounts stand unresolved; the note asserts no accusation, no reconciliation, no winner between the accounts, and no new duty beyond this crossing.
At the Chalk Stair at tick 14, the clerk filed both pending accounts and recorded the matter OPEN, asserting no finding and no resolution.

At the Chalk Stair at tick 15, the clerk records that the crossing-window named in the original minute has closed; the agreement was unfulfilled; no claim was lodged; the matter stands as a historical open entry.
